name: Mebanazine
summary: Mebanazine (trade name Actomol) is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine chemical class that was previously used as an antidepressant in the 1960s, but has since been withdrawn due to hepatotoxicity.

summaryZh: 美巴那肼（商品名Actomol）是一種單胺氧化酶抑制劑，化學式為C8H12N2。它於1960年代曾用作抗抑鬱藥，但現因其肝毒性而被撤回。動物實驗發現美巴那肼是比苯異丙肼更強的單胺氧化酶抑制劑，治療指數更大。
